notes: Modified cash basis audit. Governmental lines from the Statement of Assets and Fund Balances and Receipts, Disbursements and Changes in Fund Balances - Governmental Funds (labels on p6/p8/p10, Total Governmental Funds column on p7/p9/p11). The statement lists spending by object only (no functions); each object line takes the function of the fund that holds most of it (Fire Department Expenses = public safety), marked review. Capital outlay (Equipment, Buildings; Fire Department Fund) labelled 'Capital Outlay' (no function printed). Cash vs fund balance: the statements print beginning/ending 'Modified Cash Basis Fund Balance' (413,099.69 / 509,635.01); beginning cash is not printed separately, so beginning_cash is null; ending cash = total assets (cash and deposits + county treasurer) 509,635.01. Fund-balance roll-forward ties: 413,099.69 + 270,219.71 - 173,684.39 + 5,898.02 - 5,898.02 = 509,635.01. Business-type (Water, Sewer) from the modified cash proprietary statement p12 (same figures as the Statement of Activities p2-3); cash 26,333.83 -> 2,388.15 ties. Sales tax collected on utility bills is shown as a receipt and remitted as 'Sales Tax Remittance'. Balance sheet: governmental lines from the governmental funds statement (p11; totals equal the government-wide figures), business-type lines from the Statement of Net Position p1. Detail: General Fund combining receipts (p13, General / Fire Department / Ball Park / Bank Building columns; no budget column printed in the trim, report p28 not trimmed) and disbursements (p14; only fund-level 'Original & Final Budgeted Disbursements' printed: General 159,191.41, Fire 343,353.40, Ball Park 63,497.12, Bank Building 7,324.39); Street Fund budget schedule (p15; lines with no actual - Miscellaneous receipts budget 1,000, capital outlay Equipment 18,558.19 and Improvements other than Buildings 30,000 budgets - not recorded); proprietary budget schedule (p16) per fund, its single combined budget column (e.g. total operating disbursements budget 1,192,540.87, grant funds 1,000,000, transfers in 20,000) not assignable to a fund, so budget_final null. Bank Building Fund had no receipts (total 0.00). p17 combined statement of changes in fund balances (unaudited) is a summary and ties to the above. Read pages 1-17 of 17
